data.title: bn-w5my: .reg registry-delta sidecars in backup and verify
data.description: Two mechanical additions plus tests. BACKUP: sealed/seg-x.reg joins the cut list next to .pcol and .filter, same sidecar role and same discardable classification; .par stays excluded. New store::reg_path plus SegmentFile.reg_path/has_reg (authority.rs now reads the field instead of recomputing the path). VERIFY: a verify_reg pass mirroring verify_pcol. RegistryDelta::open covers magic, format_version, flags and the end to end crc32c; then SealedSegmentIndex::accepts_registry_delta, the engine's own admission predicate, runs against the pointer directory of whichever artifact serves the segment (pack over shadowed pidx). Kinds: reg-io, reg-corrupt, reg-layout-mismatch at Error severity matching pcol-corrupt, and reg-verified at Ok. Absence is silent at every severity including next to a pack, which by design has no sibling; a damaged pidx is not charged to the delta, the layout step is skipped instead. Docs: spec 07 lists .reg in the loose sidecar family in three places. Tests: backup round trip asserting the .reg is in the cut rows and the manifest and that the rebuilt store reports registry_delta_admitted 1 and fallback 0, against a second rebuild of the same backup with the delta removed which flips to 0 and 1 with identical events; ten cases in the new tests/registry_delta_verify.rs; corruption class 6 in corruption_detection.rs. Green: cargo test -p mess-cli all green, cargo check --workspace --all-targets, just fmt-check, clippy -p mess-cli clean. Did not run mess-bench.
